description_en: Changes the protection edition bound to a server after you activate the pay-as-you-go billing method for host and container security
description_zh: 开通主机及容器安全按量付费后，为服务器更换绑定的防护版本
name: UpdatePostPaidBindRel

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to bind all servers. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
fields.help_zh:
是否全量绑定。默认false，取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bind_all

fields.help_en:
The protection edition of Security Center to bind. Valid values:  
1: Free Edition 
3: Enterprise Edition
5: Advanced Edition
6: Anti-virus Edition    
7: Ultimate Edition
fields.help_zh:
需要绑定的云安全中心防护版本。 取值：  
1：免费版 
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版    
7：旗舰版
fields.name: version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic binding for new assets. Valid values:

0: disabled
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启新增资产自动绑定。取值：

0：关闭
1：开启
parameters.name: auto_bind

parameters.help_en:
The edition to automatically bind when new assets are added. Valid values:
1: Free Edition 
3: Enterprise Edition
5: Advanced Edition
6: Anti-virus Edition    
7: Ultimate Edition
parameters.help_zh:
新增资产时自动绑定的版本，取值：
1：免费版 
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版    
7：旗舰版
parameters.name: auto_bind_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly upgrade the edition
parameters.name: update_if_necessary

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests must use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token
